items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01

ctx.x: But did Black Benny travel with you? I didn't know he ever went anyplace except for him.
Yes, yes, we taken him. You are. Yes, he could. Mac would be the only one he'd go away with because he knew Mr. Mac would come back home.
I didn't think he ever went anyplace.
